verdicts.title: Test ideals via algebras of $p^{-e}$-linear maps
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
Continuing ideas of a recent preprint of Schwede arXiv:0906.4313 we study test ideals by viewing them as minimal objects in a certain class of $F$-pure modules over algebras of p^{-e}-linear operators. This shift in the viewpoint leads to a simplified and generalized treatment, also allowing us to define test ideals in non-reduced settings.

verdicts.title: Geometric Satake correspondence for affine Kac-Moody Lie algebras of type $A$
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This is an informal expository article on geometric Satake correspondence for affine Kac-Moody Lie algebras of type $A$ given in arXiv:1810.04293. We emphasize formal analogies between this result and the author's earlier results on geometric approaches to the representation via quiver varieties.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes a geometric Satake correspondence for affine Kac-Moody Lie algebras of type A, with no mention of algebraic stacks' minimal rank, branching programs, or refutation complexity bounds. It shares no substantive content with the conjecture.
